candidate_evidence.quote: A study to determine the feasibility and safety of individualized cancer stem cell targeted therapy based on high-throughput functional profiling of FDA/EMA-approved drugs in patients with GBM that has recurred or progressed following standards-of-care (RT, TMZ).

role_evidence.quote: A personalized drug combination will be prescribed to each patient based on the functional drug screen

agents.drug_class_hint: personalized combination of FDA/EMA-approved drugs selected by high-throughput ex vivo drug sensitivity screening of autologous cancer stem cells; no drugs named

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). No specific drugs named; coded per C13 as unspecified_approved_panel. Functional ex vivo drug screen is not a molecular biomarker, so no biomarker rows. Regimen coded combination because the intervention is a personalized drug combination.
